User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the ValueCart application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

profileImageUrl.description: URL of the user's profile image.

isAdmin.description: Indicates if the user has administrative privileges.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product available for purchase.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product entity.

specifications.description: Technical specifications of the product (e.g., size, weight, dimensions).

ProductPriceHistory.title: ProductPriceHistory
ProductPriceHistory.description: Represents the price history of a product.

id.description: Unique identifier for the price history entry.

price.description: The price of the product at a specific point in time.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the price was recorded.

CartItem.title: CartItem
CartItem.description: Represents an item within a shared shopping cart.

id.description: Document ID, same as productId for simplicity.

quantity.description: Quantity of the product in the cart.

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description: Represents a user's budget for shopping.

id.description: Unique identifier for the budget entity.

categoryLimits.description: Specific budget limits for different product categories. Stored as a JSON string

sharedUsers.description: References to Users that can see this budget. (Relationship: User N:N Budget)

id.description: Unique identifier for the address entity.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this address.

addressLine1.description: Street address, P.O. box, company name, c/o.

addressLine2.description: Apartment, suite, unit, building, floor, etc.

Purchase.title: Purchase
Purchase.description: Represents a completed purchase made by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the purchase entity.

items.description: An array of objects representing the items purchased.

purchaseDate.description: The date and time when the purchase was made.

totalAmount.description: The total amount of the purchase.

status.description: The current status of the order.

deliveryAddress.description: The delivery address for this purchase.

cancelledByUserId.description: The UID of the user who cancelled the order.

cancelledByUserName.description: The name of the user who cancelled the order.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents a notification for a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the notification entity.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the notification was created.

type.description: The type of notification (e.g., price drop, new recommendation).

RecommendationLog.title: RecommendationLog
RecommendationLog.description: Represents a log entry for a product recommendation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the recommendation log entity.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the recommendation was generated.

algorithm.description: The algorithm used to generate the recommendation (e.g., content-based, collaborative filtering).

ItemEmbedding.title: ItemEmbedding
ItemEmbedding.description: Represents the embedding vector for a product used in the recommendation engine.

productId.description: Unique identifier for the product entity.

embedding.description: The embedding vector for the product.

Invitation.title: Invitation
Invitation.description: Represents an invitation to share a budget.

fromUserId.description: The UID of the user who sent the invitation.

fromUserName.description: The name of the user who sent the invitation.

toUserEmail.description: The email of the user receiving the invitation.

budgetId.description: The ID of the budget being shared.

budgetName.description: The name of the budget being shared (denormalized).

status.description: The current status of the invitation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the invitation was created.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure is designed to support the ValueWise Cart application, emphasizing security, scalability, and ease of debugging. The structure follows the principles of Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, Access Modeling, and Data Clarity. Authorization Independence is achieved primarily through denormalization, specifically for collaborative data like `budgets` where `sharedUsers` are critical for authorization. The `sharedUsers` array in `budgets` provides a local authorization context, eliminating the need for `get()` calls in security rules to verify shared access, thus ensuring atomic operations. Structural Segregation is enforced by dedicating specific collections to different access needs. For instance, user-specific data is stored under `/users/{userId}/...`, ensuring that rules can be applied consistently across the collection based on the authenticated user. A new `/budgets/{budgetId}/cart` subcollection is added to manage the shared cart for each budget, allowing multiple users to interact with the same cart in real-time. A new `/users/{userId}/addresses` collection is added for user-specific delivery addresses. Access Modeling employs path-based ownership (e.g., `/users/{userId}/purchases/{purchaseId}`) and membership maps (`sharedUsers` in `/budgets/{budgetId}`). Data Clarity is maintained through explicit state modeling, predictable schemas, and consistent naming conventions. A new `/invitations` collection is added to manage the budget sharing workflow, allowing users to invite others and for invitees to accept or decline.
